list_subtitle.str_subtitle: After the storm, the house stands in chaos—but together, they’re ready to rebuild.
Oh no, the house is so messy, Mom!
Don't worry, honey, we'll start tidying up right away.
With the living room restored, laughter fills the home once more.
We've both worked very hard, my dear.
Can I play with the puppy now, Mom?
Of course, my dear, we'll go out and play together!
